WITH stale_jobs AS (
            UPDATE fingerprint_jobs
            SET status = 'failed', error_message = 'Max retries exceeded after timeout'
            WHERE status = 'processing'
            AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'
            AND attempts >= 3
            RETURNING track_id
        )
        UPDATE tracks
        SET status = 'error'
        WHERE id IN (SELECT track_id FROM stale_jobs)
